hooks.command: bash -c 'PID_DIR=/tmp/ivy-lsp-pids; for f in "$PID_DIR"/lsp-*.pid; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; p=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$p" ] && kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null && kill -TERM "$p" 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$f"; done; exit 0'
